//Build QLever without a dependency on ICU (International Components
// for Unicode). When ON, `find_package(ICU)` is skipped, the ICU
// libraries are not linked, and the `QLEVER_NO_UNICODE` macro
// is defined. In this mode all string comparisons, sorting, case
// conversion and normalization operate on plain ASCII bytes instead
// of proper Unicode collation. This is intended for minimal or
// embedded builds where ICU is unavailable; do not enable it if
// you need correct Unicode handling.
